technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI, candlestick pattern) show bullish structure, but lack confirmation from MACD, moving average alignment, and trend strength; price remains below key intermediate/long-term MAs with overbought oscillators suggesting limited upside without pullback.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 14 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minor confirmation; no recent news sentiment available to validate setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings binary in 14 days compounds downside risk for ABT.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI bullish, three white soldiers, supertrend) combined with extreme fear sentiment (18/100) and contrarian buy signal creates a classic capitulation setup near support (94.08).
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, weak trend strength (ADX 19.36), high earnings risk in 14 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and below-average volume all indicate this is a bear trap rally lacking structural confirmation.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (18/100) and short-term momentum (RSI bullish, three white soldiers) create a contrarian setup near support, the confluence of overbought oscillators, price below both 50/200-EMAs, weak trend strength (ADX 19.36), and high earnings risk in 14 days makes this a bear trap rally lacking structural confirmation.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 14 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (312.3), and NFP volatility in 2 days creates severe downside risk that outweighs short-term momentum.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all flag structural weakness; only sentiment offers contrarian support, but insufficient to override macro/earnings headwinds
